📺 Fallout (2024–Present)

Fallout follows a group of survivors living in a post-apocalyptic world more than 200 years after a devastating nuclear war destroyed modern civilization. Raised inside a luxurious underground shelter known as Vault 33, Lucy MacLean has spent her entire life believing in the safety and values of her sheltered community. However, when a shocking event forces her to venture into the dangerous wasteland of Los Angeles, she discovers a brutal world filled with mutated creatures, ruthless factions, and mysterious survivors. Along the way, her journey becomes connected to Maximus, a young soldier from the Brotherhood of Steel, and the Ghoul, a mysterious bounty hunter with a complicated past. Starring Ella Purnell, Aaron Moten, and Walton Goggins, the series combines thrilling action, dark comedy, and science-fiction adventure while exploring survival, morality, power, and humanity’s struggle to rebuild civilization.

🎭 Genre: Sci-Fi • Action • Adventure • Drama • Dark Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 8.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–75 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Graham Wagner & Geneva Robertson-Dworet

🎮 Based On: The Fallout video game franchise

🏆 Awards: Winner of two Primetime Emmy Awards.

📺 Where to Watch: Amazon Prime Video in the United States.
